Author: Vivek Agarwal

1   IN THE HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH  AT JABALPUR  WP No. 27476 of 2025  (SHRI HAJI ABDUL RAJJAK Vs THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADE  Dated : 01-04-2026

sentences.text: Shri Mohammad Ali - Learned Senior Advocate assisted by  Farooqui and Shri A.S. Hussain, Advocate for the petitioner.
Shri Harpreet Singh Ruprah and Shri Manas Mani Verma-  Government Advocate for the respondents No.1 to 7/State.
Shri Mihir Agrawal - Advocate for the respondent No.8.

Shri Sonu Kurmi, CSP, Omti has been called by Shri H.S.Ruprah, learned Additional Advocate General for the State to answer our queries inasmuch as Shri H.S.Ruprah was not in a position to answer our queries.
The FIR pertaining to Crime No.176/2023 was registered at Omti Police Station on 30.3.2023 at 16.51 hours for the offence under Section 165A, 294, 506 of the I.P.C.
The complainant Shri Ankit Mishra stated that the incident took place at Victoria Hospital on 30.3.2023 between 13.30 hours to 14.40 hours.

In column 12 of the FIR, it is mentioned that because Shri Ankit Mishra had a pain in the chest in the previous night on 30.3.23 at 1:00 PM, he had gone to the Victoria Hospital alongwith his friend and when he was returning from the hospital after showing himself to the doctor alongwith Sandeep then he had met Abdul Rajjak alias Rajjak Pahalwan, R/o.Ripta Naya Mohalla, who was coming with the police to the hospital.
After seeing the complainant, he got excited and started using abusive languages.

He stated that since Ankit Mishra had lodged previous report for 2 WP-27476-2025 the offence under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120B of the I.P.C against Rajjak Pahalwan, therefore, he pressurized him to take back that report.

In this backdrop, when we wanted to know from Shri Sonu Kurmi, CSP that whether investigation is complete and what is the evidence that Abdul Rajjak had visited Victoria Hospital then he said that he will be able to answer queries of this Court after looking into the case diary.
Shri Sonu Kurmi stated that case diary is outside the Court.
We had requested the Government Advocates to go and ask to call the person, who as per Shri Sonu Kurmi was waiting outside the Court with the case diary.

sentences.text: Both the Government Advocates Shri Ajay Tamrakar and Shri Abhishek Singh informed us that nobody is waiting outside the Court with the case diary.

It will not be out of context to mention that when Shri Sonu Kurmi appeared before this Court then before asking any question, we had categorically asked him as to when he joined at police station Omti to which he replied that he joined Omti Police Station in February, 2025.

We categorically asked him as to whether he is aware of the matter, which are pending before this Court and also the matters with regard to Abdul Rajjak, he submitted that since he has sworn in the affidavit, he has complete knowledge about the matter.
Thus, after verifying and obtaining consent of Shri Sonu Kurmi that he is acquainted with the matter and will be able to answer our queries, we started interrogation.

We asked him as to when investigation was completed 3 WP-27476-2025 in Crime No.176/2023 and what material was collected and whether final report was filed or not, he submitted that he has no knowledge about these facts.
Interestingly, Crime No.176/2023 is from Omti Police Station and not from any other police station.
Therefore, CSP was required to have knowledge before coming to the Court.
This reflects that CSP has not come to the Court with clean hands.
Either he has not read the file or he is trying to suppress the material.

At this stage, we had requested learned Additional Advocate General for the State to call the Superintendent of Police, Jabalpur to answer our queries because for continuous non-cooperation on the part of the police official and the Government Advocates, we cannot keep adjourning the case again and again.
On 18.3.2026 also, we had to adjourn the case because learned Additional Advocate General and the Government Advocates and the Police Officers, who were present, were not ready with the matter.

Since the matter was part heard despite decision of the Hon'ble Chief Justice to assign a different member to this Bench, I had requested Hon'ble Shri Justice Ratnesh Chandra Singh Bisen to be part of this Division Bench inasmuch as this matter was part heard alongwith him.

Thus, it is evident that not only our judicial time is being encroached but due to non-preparedness by learned Additional Advocate General and Police Officers but also they are appearing to drag the matter for one or the other reason, which clearly establishes their dishonest intention.

Similarly, in relation to Crime No.257/2023 was registered on 4 WP-27476-2025 14.05.2023 at Police Station Omti and when we enquired from Shri Sonu Kurmi, CSP, Omti that the incident is said to have taken place on 20.08.2020 and the report was lodged on 14.5.2023 at Police Station Omti at 00.19 hours.
When there is delay of about 3 years in lodging of the FIR whether any investigation is carried out before taking down FIR or it is directly written.
To this query, Shri Sonu Kurmi, CSP submitted that first preliminary investigation is carried out and then report is lodged.

sentences.text: When we asked Shri Sonu Kurmi to bring on record copy of the investigation report or preliminary investigation report, then he is not in a position to cooperate.

At this stage, the Superintendent of Police, Jabalpur Shri Sampat Upadhyay is attending the Court on our request and we asked him to depute one officer or a team of officers to answer our queries with regard to this case where several FIRs have been filed, he submits that Shri Sonu Kurmi has been deputed to answer queries of this Court.
Shri Sonu Kurmi shall prepare and answer queries of this Court tomorrow.
The case will be taken up tomorrow i.e.2.4.2026 as first matter at 10:30 AM.

Similarly, we asked the Superintendent of Police, Jabalpur that why on 27.4.2022, the Police Station Barela in Crime No.150/2022 had issued a notice under Section 41A of the Cr.P.C to Abdul Rajjak when he was already in custody, then he admitted that there was no need for issuance of such notice when Abdul Rajjak was already suffering imprisonment at Central 5 WP-27476-2025 Jail, Jabalpur
This exposes the hollowness of the cases prepared by the police authorities one after another.

It is pointed out that the passport of the petitioner is seized in the matter pertaining to Crime No.424/2021 and that matter is pending before learned Judicial Magistrate First Class Smt.Subhangi Palo Datt at Court Room No.21, Jabalpur.
Let original record pertaining to Crime No.424/2021 be sent to this Court for reference by 10:30 AM tomorrow.
Registry is also directed to send a requisition in this regard to the Principal District Judge, Jabalpur.
(VIVEK AGARWAL) (RATNESH CHANDRA SINGH
